name: Optolink-Web
description: Lightweight web UI and diagnostics for an existing Viessmann Optolink-Splitter over TCP and MQTT.

notes.text: This container does not need USB passthrough. Point it at an existing Optolink-Splitter TCP endpoint in /etc/optolink-web.env.
Web writes are disabled by default and require ALLOW_WRITES=true plus an explicitly whitelisted datapoint.
